pli-tv-kd11:1.1.2: I. Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd11:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena Paṇḍukalohitakā bhikkhū attanā bhaṇḍanakārakā kalahakārakā vivādakārakā bhassakārakā saṃghe adhikaraṇakārakā, ye pi c' aññe bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā kalahakārakā vivādakārakā bhassakārakā saṃghe adhikaraṇakārakā te upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd11:1.1.4: mā kho tumhe āyasmanto eso ajesi,
pli-tv-kd11:1.1.6: tumhe tena paṇḍitatarā ca vyattatarā ca bahussutatarā ca alamatthatarā ca,
pli-tv-kd11:1.1.9: tena anuppannāni c' eva bhaṇḍanāni uppajjanti uppannāni ca bhaṇḍanāni bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattanti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.1: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.2: kathaṃ hi nāma Paṇḍukalohitakā bhikkhū attanā bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā ye pi c' aññe bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā te upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vakkhanti:
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.9: atha kho te bhikkhū bhavagato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.10: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Paṇḍukalohitakā bhikkhū atta' nā bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā ye pi . . . adhikaraṇakārakā te upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.20: ananucchaviyaṃ bhikkhave tesaṃ moghapurisānaṃ ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.21: kathañ hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā attanā bhaṇḍanakārakā . . .
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.22: adhikaraṇakārakā ye pi c' aññe bhikkhū . . .
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.30: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya,
pli-tv-kd11:1.2.31: atha kho taṃ bhikkhave appasannānañ c' eva appasādāya pasannānañ ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd11:1.3.1: atha kho bhagavā te bhikkhū anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya dupposatāya mahicchatāya asantuṭṭhiyā saṃgaṇikāya kosajjassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitvā anekapariyāyena subharatāya suposatāya appicchassa santuṭṭhassa sallekhassa dhutassa pāsādikassa apacayassa viriyārambhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsitvā bhikkhūnaṃ tadanucchavikaṃ tadanulomikaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū amantesi:
pli-tv-kd11:1.3.2: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Paṇḍukalohitakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ tajjaniyakammaṃ karotu. ||3||
pli-tv-kd11:1.4.2: paṭhamaṃ Paṇḍukalohitakā bhikkhū codetabbā, codetvā sāretabbā, sāretvā āpattiṃ ropetabbā, āpattiṃ ropetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:1.4.4: ime Paṇḍukalohitakā bhikkhū attanā bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā ye pi c' aññe bhikkhū bhaṇḍanakārakā . . . adhikaraṇakārakā te upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadenti . . .
pli-tv-kd11:1.4.11: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho Paṇḍukalohitakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ tajjaniyakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:1.4.24: yassāyasmato khamati Paṇḍukalohitakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ tajjaniyassa kammassa karaṇaṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd11:1.4.26: dutiyam pi etam atthaṃ vadāmi . . . tatiyam pi etam atthaṃ vadāmi.
pli-tv-kd11:1.4.55: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||4||1||

pli-tv-kd11:4.1.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṃgho tajjaniyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:4.1.2: bhaṇḍanakārako hoti kalahakārako vivādakārako bhassakārako saṃghe adhikaraṇakārako,
pli-tv-kd11:4.1.5: imehi kho bhikkhave tīh' aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṃgho tajjaniyakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:4.1.6: aparehi pi bhikkhave tīh' aṅgehi . . . kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:4.1.7: adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd11:4.1.10: buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṃghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd11:4.2.1: tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṃgho tajjaniyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:4.2.3: eko bālo hoti avyatto āpattibahulo anapadāno,
pli-tv-kd11:4.2.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṃgho tajjaniyakammaṃ kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:4.2.6: aparesam pi bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ . . . kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:4.2.7: eko adhisīle sīlavipanno hoti, eko ajjhācāre ācāravipanno hoti, eko atidiṭṭhiyā diṭṭhivipanno hoti.
pli-tv-kd11:4.2.10: eko buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, eko dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, eko saṃghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
pli-tv-kd11:5.1.8: yāya āpattiyā saṃghena tajjaniyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti sā āpatti na āpajjitabbā,
pli-tv-kd11:6.1.1: atha kho saṃgho Paṇḍukalohitakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ tajjaniyakammaṃ akāsi.
pli-tv-kd11:6.1.2: te saṃghena tajjaniyakammakatā sammāvattanti lomaṃ pātenti netthāraṃ vattanti bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadenti:
pli-tv-kd11:6.1.3: mayaṃ āvuso saṃghena tajjaniyakammakatā sammāvattāma lomaṃ pātema netthāraṃ vattāma. kathaṃ nu kho amhehi paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd11:6.1.6: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Paṇḍukalohitakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ tajjaniyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetu. ||1||
pli-tv-kd11:6.2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno tajjaniyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:6.2.2: upasampādeti, nissayaṃ deti, sāmaṇeraṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, bhikkhunovādakasammutiṃ sādiyati, sammato pi bhikkhuniyo ovadati.
pli-tv-kd11:6.2.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno tajjaniyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:6.2.4: aparehi pi bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi . . . na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:6.2.5: yāya āpattiyā saṃghena tajjaniyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti taṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, aññaṃ vā tādisikaṃ, tato vā pāpiṭṭhataraṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:6.2.8: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno tajjaniyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:

pli-tv-kd11:6.2.10: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhah' aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno tajjaniyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ. ||2||

pli-tv-kd11:18.1.8: adhivāsentu me bhante therā svātanāya āgantukabhattan ti.

pli-tv-kd11:18.3.4: atha kho Citto gahapati yenāyasmā Sudhammo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sudhammaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā Sudhammo etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.6: pahūtaṃ kho te idaṃ gahapati khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.7: ekā ca kho idha n' atthi yad idaṃ tilasaṃguḷikā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.8: bahumhi vata bhante ratane buddhavacane vijjamāne ayyena Sudhammena vad eva kiñci bhāsitaṃ yad idaṃ tilasaṃguḷikā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.9: bhūtapubbaṃ bhante Dakkhiṇāpathakā vāṇijā puratthimaṃ janapadaṃ agamaṃsu vāṇijjāya,
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.11: atha kho sā bhante kukkuṭī kākena saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappesi,
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.13: yadā kho so bhante kukkuṭapotako kākavassaṃ vassitukāmo hoti kukkuṭakā 'ti vassati,
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.14: yadā kukkuṭavassaṃ vassitukāmo hoti kākā 'ti vassati.
pli-tv-kd11:18.3.15: evam eva kho bhante bahumhi ratane buddhavacane vijjamāne ayyena Sudhammena yad eva kiñci bhāsitaṃ yad idaṃ tilasaṃguḷikā 'ti. ||3||
pli-tv-kd11:18.4.1: akkosasi maṃ tvaṃ gahapati, paribhāsasi maṃ tvaṃ gahapati,
pli-tv-kd11:18.4.3: nāhaṃ bhante ayyaṃ Sudhammaṃ akkosāmi paribhāsāmi,
pli-tv-kd11:18.4.6: ahaṃ ayyassa Sudhammassa ussukkaṃ karissāmi cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānan ti.
pli-tv-kd11:18.4.8: tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Sudhammo Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd11:18.4.12: Sāvatthiṃ kho ahaṃ gahapati gamissāmi bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd11:18.4.13: tena hi bhante yañ ca attanā bhaṇitaṃ yañ ca mayā bhaṇitaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocehi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.4.14: anacchariyaṃ kho pan' etaṃ bhante yaṃ ayyo Sudhammo punad eva Macchikāsaṇḍaṃ paccāgaccheyyā 'ti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd11:18.5.1: atha kho āyasmā Sudhammo senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Sāvatthi tena pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.5.2: anupubbena yena Sāvatthi Jetavanaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd11:18.5.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sudhammo yañ ca attanā bhaṇitaṃ yañ ca Cittena gahapatinā bhaṇitaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.5.5: ananucchaviyaṃ moghapurisa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:18.5.6: kathaṃ hi nāma tvam moghapurisa Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ dāyakaṃ kārakaṃ saṃghupaṭṭhāhakaṃ hīnena khuṃsessasi hīnena vambhessasi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.5.10: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Sudhammassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ karotu
pli-tv-kd11:18.6.2: paṭhamaṃ Sudhammo bhikkhu codetabbo, codetvā sāretabbo, sāretvā āpattiṃ ropetabbo, āpattiṃ ropetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:18.6.4: ayaṃ Sudhammo bhikkhu Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ dāyakaṃ kārakaṃ saṃghupaṭṭhāhakaṃ hīnena khuṃsesi hīnena vambhesi.
pli-tv-kd11:18.6.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho Sudhammassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ kareyya
pli-tv-kd11:18.6.12: yassāyasmato khamati Sudhammassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇiyassa kammassa karaṇaṃ Citto te gahapati khamāpetabbo 'ti so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd11:18.6.24: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||6||18||
pli-tv-kd11:20.1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamāno saṃgho paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:20.1.2: gihīnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati, gihīnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati, gihīnaṃ avāsāya parisakkati, gihī akkosati paribhāsati, gihī gihīhi bhedeti.
pli-tv-kd11:20.1.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi . . . kareyya.
pli-tv-kd11:20.1.5: gihīnaṃ buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, gihīnaṃ dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, gihīnaṃ saṃghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, gihī hīnena khuṃseti hīnena vambheti, gihīnaṃ dhammikaṃ paṭissavaṃ na saccāpeti.
pli-tv-kd11:20.1.7: pañcannaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhūnaṃ ākaṅkhamāno saṃgho paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ kareyya:
pli-tv-kd11:20.1.8: eko gihīnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati, eko gihīnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati, eko gihīnaṃ avāsāya parisakkati, eko gihī akkosati paribhāsati, eko gihī gihīhi bhedeti.
pli-tv-kd11:20.1.11: eko gihīnaṃ buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, eko gihīnaṃ dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, eko gihīnaṃ saṃghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, eko gihī hīnena khuṃseti hīnena vambheti, eko gihīnaṃ dhammikaṃ paṭissavaṃ na saccāpeti.
pli-tv-kd11:22.1.1: atha kho saṃgho Sudhammassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-kd11:22.1.3: so saṃghena paṭisāraṇiyakammakato Macchikāsaṇḍaṃ gantvā maṅkubhūto nāsakkhi Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:22.1.7: idhāhaṃ āvuso Macchikāsaṇḍaṃ gantvā maṅkubhūto nāsakkhiṃ Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetun ti.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.1: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūtaṃ detu
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.4: paṭhamaṃ bhikkhu yācitabbo, yācitvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.6: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ Sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūtaṃ dadeyya Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.9: saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ Sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūtaṃ deti Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.10: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno Sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūtassa dānaṃ Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.12: dinno saṃghena itthannāmo bhikkhu Sudhammassa bhikkhuno anudūto Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpetuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:22.2.13: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.1: tena bhikkhave Sudhammena bhikkhunā anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ Macchikāsaṇḍaṃ gantvā Citto gahapati khamāpetabbo
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.3: evañ ce vuccamāno khamati icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.4: no ce khamati anudūtena bhikkhunā vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.5: khama gahapati imassa bhikkhuno, pasādeti tan ti.
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.6: evañ ce vuccamāno khamati icc etaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.7: no ce khamati anudūtena bhikkhunā vattabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.8: khama gahapati imassa bhikkhuno, ahan taṃ pasādemīti.
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.11: khama gahapati imassa bhikkhuno saṃghassa vacanenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd11:22.3.13: no ce khamati anudūtena bhikkhunā Sudhammo bhikkhu Cittassa gahapatino dassanūpacāraṃ avijahāpetvā savanūpacāraṃ avijahāpetvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā sā āpatti desāpetabbā 'ti. ||3||22||
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.1: atha kho āyasmā Sudhammo anudūtena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ Macchikāsaṇḍaṃ gantvā Cittaṃ gahapatiṃ khamāpesi.
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.2: so sammāvattati lomaṃ pāteti netthāraṃ vattati bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.3: ahaṃ āvuso saṃghena paṭisāraṇiyakammakato sammāvattāmi lomaṃ pātemi netthāraṃ vattāmi.
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.4: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd11:23.1.6: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Sudhammassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetu. ||1||
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno paṭisāraṇiyakammaṃ
pli-tv-kd11:23.2.21: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhah' aṅgehi . . . paṭippassambhetabbaṃ. ||2||
pli-tv-kd11:24.1.24: saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā . . . (see ch. 12) . . . evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti. ||1||24||
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā Kosambiyam viharati Ghositārāme.
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Channo āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ passituṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Channo āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchissati āpattiṃ passitun ti.
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Channo bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ passitun ti.
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.11: nāma so bhikkhave moghapuriso āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchissati āpattiṃ passituṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.12: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --la--
pli-tv-kd11:25.1.15: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Channassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ karotu
pli-tv-kd11:25.2.2: paṭhamaṃ Channo bhikkhu codetabbo, codetvā sāretabbo, sāretvā āpattiṃ ropetabbo, āpattiṃ ropetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-kd11:25.2.4: ayaṃ Channo bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ passituṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:25.2.5: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ saṃgho Channassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ kareyya
pli-tv-kd11:25.2.9: ayaṃ Channo bhikkhu āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ passituṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:25.2.10: saṃgho Channassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ karoti
pli-tv-kd11:25.2.12: yassāyasmato khamati Channassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyassa kammassa karaṇaṃ
pli-tv-kd11:25.2.24: kataṃ saṃghena Channassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ
pli-tv-kd11:25.2.26: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-kd11:26.1.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgataṃ āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.1: āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammakatena bhikkhave bhikkhunā sammāvattitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.8: yāya āpattiyā saṃghena āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti sā āpatti na āpajjitabbā,
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.33: na pakatattena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekacchanne āvāse vatthabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.35: na ekacchanne āvāse vā anāvāse vā vatthabbaṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:27.1.37: na pakatatto bhikkhu āsādetabbo anto vā bahi vā,
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.1: atha kho saṃgho Channassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.3: so saṃghena āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammakato tamhā āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi,
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.4: tattha bhikkhū n' eva abhivādesuṃ na paccuṭṭhesuṃ na añjalikammaṃ na sāmīcikammaṃ akaṃsu na sakkariṃsu na garukariṃsu na mānesuṃ na pūjesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.5: so bhikkhūhi asakkariyamāno agarukariyamāno amāniyamāno apūjiyamāno asakkārapakato tamhāpi āvāsā aññaṃ āvāsaṃ agamāsi
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.6: tattha pi bhikkhū n' eva abhivādesuṃ na paccuṭṭhesuṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.8: tattha pi bhikkhū n' eva abhivādesuṃ na paccuṭṭhesuṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.10: so sammāvattati lomaṃ pāteti netthāraṃ vattati bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā evaṃ vadeti:
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.11: ahaṃ āvuso saṃghena āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammakato sammāvattāmi lomaṃ pātemi netthāraṃ vattāmi.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.12: kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd11:28.1.14: tena hi bhikkhave saṃgho Channassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetu. ||1||
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno āpa ttiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.2: upasampādeti, nissayaṃ deti, sāmaṇeraṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, bhikkhunovādakasammutiṃ sādiyati, sammato pi bhikkhuniyo ovadati.
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.3: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcah' aṅgehi . . . na paṭippassambhetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.5: yāya āpattiyā saṃghena āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ kataṃ hoti taṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, aññaṃ vā tādisikaṃ, tato vā pāpiṭṭhataraṃ,
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.9: pakatattassa bhikkhuno abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalikammaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ āsanābhihāraṃ sādiyati.
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.12: pakatattassa bhikkhuno seyyābhihāraṃ pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ pattacīvarapaṭiggahaṇaṃ nahāne piṭṭhiparikammaṃ sādiyati.
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.15: pakatattaṃ bhikkhuṃ sīlavipattiyā anuddhaṃseti, ācāravipattiyā anuddhaṃseti, diṭṭhivipattiyā anuddhaṃseti, ājīvavipattiyā anuddhaṃseti, bhikkhuṃ bhikkhūhi bhedeti.
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.18: gihidhajaṃ dhāreti, titthiyadhajaṃ dhāreti, titthiye sevati,
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.19: bhikkhū na sevati, bhikkhusikkhāya na sikkhati.
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.22: pakatattena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekacchanne āvāse vasati, ekacchanne anāvāse vasati, ekacchanne āvāse vā anāvāse vā vasati,
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.23: pakatattaṃ bhikkhuṃ disvā āsanā na vuṭṭhāti,
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.24: pakatattaṃ bhikkhuṃ āsādeti anto vā bahi vā.
pli-tv-kd11:28.2.27: pakatattassa bhikkhuno uposathaṃ ṭhapeti, pavāraṇaṃ ṭhapeti, savacanīyaṃ karoti, anuvādaṃ paṭṭhapeti, okāsaṃ kāreti, codeti, sāreti, bhikkhūhi sampayojeti.
pli-tv-kd11:29.1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno āpattiyā adassane ukkhepaniyakammaṃ paṭippassambhetabbaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:29.1.2: na upasampādeti, na nissayaṃ deti, . . . na
pli-tv-kd11:30.1.2: tena bhikkhave Channena bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ upasaṃkamitvā . . .
pli-tv-kd11:31.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
pli-tv-kd11:31.1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Channo āpattiṃ āpajjitvā na icchati āpattiṃ paṭikātuṃ . . .
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.4: assosuṃ kho sambahulā bhikkhū: Ariṭṭhassa nāma kira bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū yena Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.7: upasaṃkamitvā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.8: saccaṃ kira te āvuso Ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:32.1.10: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd11:32.2.5: anekapariyāyena āvuso Ariṭṭha antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā
pli-tv-kd11:32.2.6: alañ ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
pli-tv-kd11:32.2.7: appassādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
pli-tv-kd11:32.2.8: aṭṭhikaṅkalūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
pli-tv-kd11:32.2.17: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo 'ti.
pli-tv-kd11:32.2.18: evam pi kho Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tehi bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath' eva taṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharati:
pli-tv-kd11:32.2.19: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.1: yato kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ atha kho te bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.2: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.3: saccaṃ kira te Ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.5: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā . . . antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.6: kassa nu kho nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mayā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi.
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.7: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.8: alañ ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.9: appassādā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.19: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.20: atha ca pana tvaṃ moghapurisa attanā duggahitena amhe c' eva abbhācikkhasi attānañ ca khaṇasi bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavasi,
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.21: taṃ hi te moghapurisa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
pli-tv-kd11:32.3.22: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya . . .

pli-tv-kd11:32.4.2: paṭhamaṃ Ariṭṭho bhikkhu codetabbo, codetvā sāretabbo, sāretvā āpattiṃ ropetabbo, āpattiṃ ropetvā vyattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṃgho ñāpetabbo:

pli-tv-kd11:32.4.14: saṃgho Ariṭṭhassa bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepaniyakammaṃ karoti
pli-tv-kd11:32.4.16: yassāyasmato khamati Ariṭṭhassa bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepaniyassa kammassa karaṇaṃ
pli-tv-kd11:32.4.34: Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepaniyakammakato
pli-tv-kd11:33.1.1: tīhi bhikkhave aṅgehi . . . (=ch.2-5; instead of tajjaniyakammaṃ read: pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepaniyakammaṃ) . . .

pli-tv-kd11:34.1.3: so saṃghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepaniyakammakato vibbhami.
pli-tv-kd11:34.1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:

pli-tv-kd11:34.1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo saṃghena pāpikāya diṭṭhiyā appaṭinissagge ukkhepaniyakammakato vibbhamīti.
